title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 16: the ark placed in the tent, David's song of thanks and the Levites appointed to serve.

questions.text: What did David give to everyone of Israel, both man and woman?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:3 says he gave everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat and a cake of raisins.

answers.text: A silver coin and a new linen garment
A loaf of bread, a portion of meat and a cake of raisins
A jar of oil and a measure of fine wheat
A lamb for each household and a skin of wine

questions.text: Who was appointed as the chief of the Levites who ministered before Yahweh's ark?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 names Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah.

questions.text: To how many generations did Yahweh command his word, according to the song?
questions.explanation: The song says, "Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations."

questions.text: Which land did Yahweh say he would give as "the lot of your inheritance"?
questions.explanation: The song quotes Yahweh saying, "I will give you the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance."

questions.text: How does the song complete the words "Don't touch my ...!"?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says, "Don't touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!"

questions.text: What does the song say about all the gods of the peoples?
questions.explanation: Verse 26 says all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

questions.text: What will the trees of the forest do before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 33 says the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.

questions.text: What did all the people say at the end of David's song?
questions.explanation: After "Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel," all the people said, "Amen," and praised Yahweh.

questions.text: Where was Yahweh's tabernacle in the high place, before which David left Zadok the priest and his brothers?
questions.explanation: David left Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before Yahweh's tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon.

questions.text: What did David do after all the people departed to their houses?
questions.explanation: All the people departed, each man to his house, and David returned to bless his house.

answers.text: He returned to bless his house
